jobs.title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
jobs.description: Description BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve. This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well. The Opportunity We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made. You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency. This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand. What You'll Own Email & Retention Design Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms Web Creative & CRO Support Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs Social & Ad Creative Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed Process & Quality Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs) Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines Who You Are Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role: An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right. jobs.title: Web Designer, eCRM
jobs.description: Headquarters: Humane World for Animals URL: https://humaneworld.org The general salary range for this full-time position is $80,000 – 115,000. Salary offers will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, training and education. Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Web Developer, eCRM to support Digital Marketing and other departments by providing front-end, global web development solutions for fundraising, advocacy engagement, and other strategic priorities — incorporating AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous human oversight, quality, and security standards. Responsibilities: Collaborates regularly with Digital Marketing, Brand and Visuals, and IS teams to discuss project requirements and makes technical recommendations. Writes efficient code and maintains custom donation forms, advocacy forms, other webpages, and email templates. Incorporates best practices for user experience, accessibility, page speed optimization, and GDPR compliance implementation. Adheres to global regulations and standards, regional data compliance, and security compliance; Uses AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. Proactively identifies opportunities for AI-assisted and agent-built solutions and owns the ongoing maintenance, monitors their performance over time and updates or retires them as needed. Follows established guardrails and usage standards for AI tools and applies human-in-the-loop review to all AI-generated code and configurations, validating output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and brand/technical standards before deployment; Follows quality assurance procedures and troubleshoots technical issues affecting donation forms, advocacy forms, webpages, and email templates in Engaging Networks. Works closely with vendor partners; Works with the Information Security team to ensure that digital properties meet security standards, including managing script inventory, attestation, and other requirements for PCI compliance; Collaborates with the testing team to gather testing requirements and implement new features to run A/B and multivariate tests on forms; Creates and maintains clear and concise documentation of custom web development, support guides, and incident reports; Performs other duties as assigned. Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer programming, web development, or related field, or equivalent work experience required; A minimum of four (4) years of experience in front-end web development and developing custom websites required; Demonstrated experience with Engaging Networks or other eCRMs; Proficient in HTML5, Sass and CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, GitHub, Engaging Networks modules, Webpack, Node, npm, core AWS services, and Mailgun. Familiar with Segment or other CDPs; Direct experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot; Knowledge of best practices for responsive, mobile-first web design, UX, accessibility, page speed optimization, browser support, and GDPR compliance; Familiar with cookie consent tools, preferably Iubenda, for configuring compliance settings; Experience building interactive data visualizations that translate campaigns into compelling stories for supporters to increase engagement; Excellent attention to detail when coding projects based on Adobe XD files or Figma; Understanding of digital marketing strategies for US and international audiences; Stays on top of AI trends in web development, including personalization and workflow automation, and their responsible application to fundraising and advocacy technology; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Must be able to multi-task in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to deliver high quality work on deadline. Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus; Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics; Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment; Interest in animal protection issues preferred. This is a full-time remote position based in the United States. Candidates must be able to accomodate Eastern Time hours, as needed. Q ualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status. EOE To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/humane-world-for-animals-web-designer-ecrm-1

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Hurst, TX URL: http://bbemarketing.com/ We’re looking for a creative, curious designer who can turn entertainment and sports industry data into compelling social content. You’ll come up with ideas, identify relevant news, create graphics, write captions, and check the information before it’s published. Our audience includes entertainment and sports professionals. We need someone who understands what would make these people stop, read, share, or join the conversation. What You’ll Do Generate original content ideas. Find interesting angles in our data and industry developments, including infographics, comparisons, agency breakdowns, rankings, and recurring series. Bring ideas proactively and experiment with new formats. Create the graphics yourself. Design clear, engaging infographics, carousels, and news graphics that communicate information effectively and look polished on social media. Choose the right news stories. Review incoming industry news and decide which stories matter to our audience, why they matter, and how we should present them. Write the copy. Create headlines, on-graphic text, hooks, and captions in clear, confident English suited to an industry-professional audience. Review researchers’ work. Check the data and supporting sources provided by our research team. Verify names, agency relationships, dates, totals, percentages, and other details. Flag inconsistencies and work with researchers to resolve them. Own the final quality check. Make sure the graphic and caption match the verified data, the headline is supported, and the finished post is accurate and easy to understand. Manage the content calendar. Balance planned content with timely responses to relevant industry news. Learn from performance. Review what resonates with our audience and use those insights to improve future content. What We’re Looking For A strong graphic design portfolio, especially infographics, editorial graphics, social media carousels, or other information-focused content. The ability to take a post from initial idea through design, caption writing, and final review. Strong creative and editorial judgment. You can look at a dataset or news story, identify an interesting angle, and explain why our audience would care. Excellent written English, including the ability to make complex information clear and concise. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets, checking percentages, and reviewing sources. Proficiency in the design tools needed to produce polished graphics and organized, editable files. Initiative and curiosity. You regularly bring forward ideas, explore possibilities, and improve concepts through feedback. Strong organization, reliable communication, and the ability to manage deadlines independently. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bbe-marketing-inc-senior-graphic-designer
